# Modules and developer profiles

<p class="pm-kind"><b>Reference · generated</b> · the twelve optimization modules, and the developer profiles that select them</p>

A developer profile is a tag that `pms modules ls --for` and `pms doctor --for` take, and that the MCP `modules_list` tool takes as `profile`. It selects modules from the table below and enables nothing: `pms modules ls --for` lists them, and `pms doctor --for` adds a line naming them. An unknown profile makes `pms modules ls` exit 1 and `pms doctor` report a warning. A developer profile is not the profiles repository (`pulse-mesh-profiles`), which holds the enterprise, HFT and robotics rings.

The table is static, in `dev_ring/dev-functions/src/core_ops/modules.rs`, and this page is generated from what `pms modules ls --json` prints.

## Developer profiles

| Profile | Flag | Modules | Rings the modules sit in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hft` | `--for hft` | M01, M02, M03, M04, M09, M11 | `dev_ring`, `hft_ring` |
| `ai` | `--for ai`, `--for inference` | M01, M04, M05, M06, M07, M12 | `hft_ring`, `robotics_ring` |
| `robotics` | `--for robotics` | M03, M04, M08, M10, M12 | `hft_ring` |
| `telemetry` | `--for telemetry` | M05, M07, M08, M10 | `robotics_ring` |
| `dev` | `--for dev` | M04 | `hft_ring` |

## Modules

A module is a crate of its own or a module inside one layer of a ring (`crate::module`). The ring column names the ring whose layer holds it, and is blank for a crate of its own.

| Module | Crate or module | Ring | What it does | Developer profiles |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M01 | `hft_stages::numa` | `hft_ring` | Hugepages + NUMA-aware ring placement | `hft`, `ai` |
| M02 | `dev_stages::conflation` | `dev_ring` | Symbol-keyed last-write-wins router for quote-style traffic | `hft` |
| M03 | `hft_functions::wait` | `hft_ring` | UMWAIT / Park / BusySpin + smart poll_hint | `hft`, `robotics` |
| M04 | `hft_stages::spmc` | `hft_ring` | Lock-free SPMC ring (1 publisher, N readers) | `hft`, `ai`, `robotics`, `dev` |
| M05 | `robotics_stages::net_uring` | `robotics_ring` | io_uring batched send/recv for cross-host fan-out | `ai`, `telemetry` |
| M06 | `robotics_stages::large_payload` | `robotics_ring` | Tier-2 envelope LRU + NACK backfill | `ai` |
| M07 | `robotics_stages::autoscale` | `robotics_ring` | LagObserver + swap-ring protocol | `telemetry`, `ai` |
| M08 | `pms-telemetry-export` |  | Prometheus exporter | `telemetry`, `robotics` |
| M09 | `hft_core::prefetch` | `hft_ring` | Adaptive cache-line prefetch | `hft` |
| M10 | `pms-crc32c` |  | CRC32C trailer integrity | `robotics`, `telemetry` |
| M11 | `hft_core::wire_v2` | `hft_ring` | Wire format v2 (separate data-ready line) | `hft` |
| M12 | `mesh-broadcast` |  | In-process listener fan-out | `ai`, `robotics` |
